name: China Life Insurance Company Limited
research_rationale: Research weakens strong buy: HKEX Q3 supports resilient 9M adjusted earnings, but Yahoo's Q3 statutory loss and screen–Yahoo FCF gaps leave cheapness unconfirmed.

weekly_updates.summary:
HKEX sources now index eleven annual, interim and quarterly filing bodies, including the 30 Oct 2026 third-quarter report (9M adjusted profit +15.8% per filing narrative).  
Yahoo still shows a Q3 statutory net loss and negative revenue; commentary in the news batch flags value-trap risk after a ~15% pullback.  
Material FCF and earnings-growth divergence versus the strong-buy screen metrics is unchanged.
